key_insight: CauTrace diagnoses ordinary and adversarial LLM failures through shared internal measures of support, commitment, verification, and reasoning trajectories.
engineering_relevance: White-box process diagnostics can complement output-level testing by identifying internal failure patterns that may inform targeted repair and steering.
method: Define seven functional states for support and constraint processing.
Measure how state-related representation changes persist across Transformer blocks.
Track support, commitment, and verification timing alongside dominant-state trajectories.
evidence_signal: Across Qwen and LLaMA-family evaluations of clean reasoning failures and paired adversarial perturbations, failed traces showed weaker Attention–MLP agreement on support updates and less verification relative to commitment.
watch_item: Signatures and timing vary by architecture, while repair and steering evidence is limited to specific models and settings; implementation also requires internal model access.
paper_title: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
